rotation.title: Random Doubles Planner
rotation.setupDescription: Build a fair doubles schedule with unique partners, then run every court from one live screen.
rotation.noRepeatPromise: Every player gets the requested number of matches with a different partner each time.

validation.matchesPerPlayer: Matches per player must be between 1 and {{maximumMatches}}.
validation.divisibility: Players × matches per player must be divisible by 4.
validation.courtCount: Court count must be between 1 and {{maximumCourts}}.

rotation.uniqueNames: Each name must be filled in and unique.
rotation.namesError: Enter a different name for every player.
rotation.generationDescription: Balancing partners, opponents, and rest time. This may take a moment for larger groups.
rotation.scoreInvalid: Use whole, non-negative scores. The winner needs at least 11 points and a two-point margin.
rotation.flexibleHint: Start the next eligible match when a court is free.
rotation.waitingPlayers: Waiting for players to leave the other court.
rotation.queueEmpty: Every match has started or finished.
rotation.playersBusy: One or more players are currently on court.
rotation.blocksOtherCourts: Choose another match first to keep every court playable.
rotation.rankingNote: 1 point for each win. A loss earns 0 points.
rotation.regenerateConfirm: Replace this unplayed schedule with a newly randomized one?
rotation.resetConfirm: Delete the current rotation event and all of its results? This does not affect league data.
